Subject and scene: A colossal weather-worn stone figure kneels in green English-like chalk downs, its bowed head a grassy hill with sheep grazing. Its hollow torso forms a towering rib-vault shelter, and warm honey-colored lanterns glow between broken stone ribs. A narrow shepherd path approaches from the lower left; two tiny pack-mule travellers arrive with cooking pots. Its stone hands cup a spring and rough communal hearths shelter underneath. Ancient, gentle, moving rather than frightening; sunset after rain, warm amber interior against blue-green hills. The colossus is an ancient carved monument, not a living flesh creature.

Subject and scene: A vast ruined stone aqueduct rises from a lush lowland river marsh. Subject and scene: A cathedral-sized translucent volcanic-glass sculpture of a whale rests across a high copper-colored mountain terrace, far from any sea. Its ribs and curved jaw glow with embedded amber and smoky blue glass, eroded and chipped rather than pristine. The whale has a beautiful unmistakable whole-body silhouette with a great rising tail; tiny awnings and an assayer's open-air stall stand safely beside its jaw, and a mule caravan approaches through dry stone terraces. Subject and scene: Above an ochre desert cistern, seven immense basalt fragments float in a broken circular crown around the remnant of a stone tower. Subject and scene: At the foot of a rugged western seacoast, a vast old conservatory of green sea-glass and pale stone has been partly submerged by centuries of tides. At this low tide the ribbed glass dome and arcaded upper terrace gleam among tidal pools; fish flicker below the transparent floor, kelp waves around lower columns, and luminous water reflections dance across ruined vaulted walls. Subject and scene: An island-sized ancient sea tortoise rests peacefully in a warm shallow bay, its broad mossy shell carrying a small terraced orchard of pear, fig and citrus trees with old dry-stone retaining walls. Its wise blunt head and one huge flipper are clearly visible above turquoise water, making its living nature unmistakable. Only a simple caretaker shelter and a few tiny orchard workers occupy the shell; two modest sailing boats wait at a rope pontoon beyond the flipper. Glowing golden afternoon, a quiet archipelago in the distance, dense varied green canopy, pale shell ridges and white seabirds.
